It is the kit-first, hero-first template, and its Meta ads are live to study.

top3_for_owner.example: MasterPieces playbook, read with the Swoveralls counter-data
top3_for_owner.why: A process a solo operator can run (outreach quota, samples to vetted creators, boost proven affiliate videos), with a realistic $35K/month GMV ceiling (CLAIMED). Swoveralls shows the failure mode: more than $2 spent per $1 of GMV and about 99% of creators selling nothing, so gate samples and track contribution per creator.

Validated demand with $20-30/day Meta lead-ad tests and pre-orders before inventory, then reported about 30% profit after ads with email at about 20% of revenue (REPORTED). This fits the $1,800 budget and Dhruv's software edge (landing pages, email, dashboards).
